title: Every page preloads three DAWN fonts that the Frequency design does not draw

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail:
FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: production HTML (/, /pricing, /discover/events, an event page) carries five <link rel=preload as=font>: Nunito, Geist Mono and Anton from app/layout.tsx plus Unbounded and Hanken Grotesk from lib/theme/design-fonts/frequency.ts. Only app/themes/frequency/space-page.css references a DAWN face. Three wasted woff2 downloads compete with the hero on every first paint on a phone. THE FIX: preload the three DAWN faces only when FONTS_DESIGN is 'dawn' (they still load on demand where space-page.css asks).

Nunito, Geist Mono and Anton carry preload: false in app/layout.tsx, so no route preloads a DAWN face; they still load on demand where a Space page draws them.
